title.zh: 由发布清单驱动的详细项目报告

purpose.en: Make every smartlingo.net Project report describe the exact deployment instead of reusing stale or generic release text.
purpose.zh: 确保 smartlingo.net 的每份项目报告准确说明本次部署，不再复用过期或笼统的发布文案。

en: Add a site-local, release-specific manifest as the source of Project report titles and notes.
Validate required release purpose, scope, implementation, verification, and deferred-test details before deployment.
Show the current release details with the exact commit and GitHub Actions run in Project history.
Fail production verification unless the latest matching commit contains this manifest's title and deployment purpose.
zh: 新增站点独立、本次发布专属的清单，作为项目报告标题和说明的来源。
部署前校验发布目的、范围、实现、验证和延后测试等必填详情。
在项目历史中显示本次发布详情、精确 commit 和 GitHub Actions 运行记录。
只有最新匹配 commit 同时包含本清单标题与部署目的时，生产验证才可通过。
GitHub Actions 正式部署流水线
项目运行时发布报告对账

en: Replace workflow-level stale release copy with versioned repository data.
Preserve the site's existing branding, Project schema, cloud bindings, and historical release records.
Replace history-wide string searches with exact current-build semantic verification.
zh: 使用仓库内版本化数据替代工作流中的过期固定发布文案。
保留本站品牌、项目数据结构、云资源绑定和历史发布记录。
使用当前构建精确语义校验替代对全部历史记录的字符串搜索。

en: Existing site automated contract tests, type checks, and production build
Successful Cloudflare deployment and production Project report inspection
zh: 发布清单结构与语义详情校验
本站既有自动化契约测试、类型检查和正式构建
Cloudflare 成功部署及生产项目报告内容检查

en: Full cross-site interactive realtime testing is intentionally not required for this reporting-pipeline migration.
zh: 本次报告流水线迁移按全站发布规则不执行逐站完整实时互动测试。

en: Keep smartlingo.net data, identity, deployment credentials, and production resources isolated.
zh: 保持 smartlingo.net 的数据、身份系统、部署凭据和生产资源完全独立。
